rows.text: # Body recall baseline checkpoint

2026-09-12. Implements [body-recall-recency-component/0.1-candidate](../formal/BODY_RECALL_RECENCY_COMPONENT.md)
under the [accepted A law](GENERAL_ATTENTION_BODY_RECALL_LAW_RESOLUTION.md).
[Fourteen combined tests pass](BODY_RECALL_TESTS_REV1.json): eight body cases plus
six partition cases. [Five actual source faults](BODY_RECALL_REVIEW_REV1.json) are
detected: oldest-first, self-cue, reversed tie, refreshed time and group-only recall.

Older eligible acquisitions remain retained while losing recall slots. Additional
groups/views supply no advantage. Co-acquired surviving groups are returned at the
acquisition target, removed groups stay absent, original time is preserved, and
returned byte mutation cannot alter retained memory. Absent and unmatched cues yield
no result; zero slots is ordinary exclusion.

BR-D preserves zero-valued retained bytes; it does not prove a public numeric-zero
observation produces a cue. The component accepts supplied cue identities. That missing
producer now requires the [source-coupling decision](GENERAL_ATTENTION_BODY_CUE_SOURCE_DECISION.md).
Public observer/source admission, read-only facade, acquisition result codecs,
persistence and corpus qualification remain open. No allocation or public activation.
# Independent body cue checkpoint

2026-09-12. [Thirteen tests pass](BODY_SIGNAL_CUE_TESTS_REV1.json): five cue cases plus
eight body recall cases. [Five source faults](BODY_SIGNAL_CUE_REVIEW_REV1.json) detect
ignored permission, absence-as-cue, foreign observer, repeated source and suppressed cue.

Actual461/463 record codecs are used. A present0..1 interval cues retained alpha while
the actual durable selector at capacity0 returns no groups. The coupled comparator
fails to recall there and converges at capacity1. No memory bytes change; the existing
opportunity17 is preserved. Permission without present evidence, denied evidence and
unavailable samples yield no cue. Magnitude change does not change identity eligibility.

The result has only safe cue/provenance fields, not sample payload. Public producer
completion and opportunity association are not authenticated by this component. Reading
an accepted version string is not a proof of origin. Existing embodiedAdmission shows
the necessary distinction: it binds actual completed source/carrier and reserved SEM
experience before admitting a downstream use. The new independent cue must receive
its own explicit recipient binding rather than inherit pressure or durable-selection
permission by calling their ingress functions.

Next: exact public cue carrier, source/recipient association, safe signal declaration
roles and read-only body recall registration. Preserve all frozen EMB producer versions;
the three-reserve source successor still requires its complete packaging gate. No public
cue, allocation, canonical recall persistence or General Attention completion is claimed.
# Current body cue source: acquisition coupling decision

2026-09-12. **DECISION REQUIRED.** Exact signal matching, acquisition-level recall,
recency ordering and separate retrieval partitions remain accepted. The public producer
of the lawful current cue is not fixed by those laws.
## Inspection

interoceptiveSignalSelection consumes actual bounded observed sample records, groups
them by governed safe signal declarations, and returns selected groups under durable-
acquisition capacity. The source and the selected view are distinct. A permitted
observed signal can therefore exist without entering durable acquisition. The current
body recall component instead consumes an already-admitted Present/Absent cue and
does not authenticate its origin. Reusing the selected view is possible but would
introduce acquisition-selection → recall-cue availability as a causal dependency.

The accepted cue law prohibits self-cueing and requires actual current safe evidence.
It does not state that evidence must also win durable encoding. Conversely, permission
alone is not a completed cue: neither alternative may invent a cue without an actual
source occurrence and explicitly admitted cue evaluation.
## Alternatives

**A — separately admitted current signal cue, independent of durable-acquisition
selection (recommended).** An explicit bounded recall-cue opportunity consumes current
observer-safe signal evidence from its real admitted observation producer and governed
channel-to-signal projection. It may name a signal that did not win durable acquisition.
It still requires its own cue permission/eligibility, exact completed source, observer,
time and subject binding. No automatic cue is emitted merely because sensing is allowed.

Thus reducing durable-acquisition capacity to zero can prevent a new memory while a
separately admitted current cue recalls an older surviving acquisition. Do not give
cue evaluation write access or implicitly form a new acquisition, enroll a phantom
formation source, or expose physical reserve keys. The cue stores only the safe signal
identity and accepted provenance; raw samples never become an archive resolver.

**B — current cue requires winning the durable-acquisition selection gate.** Only an
actually selected current signal group can supply a cue. Hold old memory and actual
observations fixed: reducing acquisition capacity can suppress recall by excluding
the relevant signal. The successful cue does not itself require new formation success,
but it requires selection. This shares one scarce gate across new acquisition and
access to old body memories. It is a coherent stronger coupling, not an identity rule.
## Discriminating public experiment

Retain an old alpha acquisition. Supply a real current permitted alpha observation
and an explicit recall opportunity. Set durable-acquisition capacity to zero while
keeping recall slots positive. A can recall the old acquisition under separate cue
admission; B cannot produce alpha's cue. Then enable acquisition selection and require
the distinction to collapse. This is a proposed public witness, not an executed source
test; current component cues were supplied directly.

For either option, numeric-zero observations remain eligible evidence as declared by
the cue producer, while unavailable/denied/no completed source gives no cue. Wrong-
observer, stale, copied provenance and physical-key inputs reject. No remembered
content or old source ID can synthesize fresh evidence. Interoceptive graph and
presentation reinforcement remain excluded. Reuse actual sensing opportunity identity
where its contract permits; do not allocate a second sensing occurrence by assumption.

Recommendation A preserves the separation of durable acquisition and access to prior
memory. B remains an explicit shared-gate control. This choice changes a causal edge
and potentially recall behavior, so it must not be buried in producer wiring. Public
source schema, exact permissions and work/byte bounds follow the ruling; no new
source mechanism, numeric allocation or public cue implementation is made here.
# Independent current body cue admission: A accepted

2026-09-12. **ACCEPTED by supplied planning ruling.** Resolves
GENERAL_ATTENTION_BODY_CUE_SOURCE_DECISION. Current sensing may make old memory
retrievable without winning new durable acquisition. Encoding and cue admission are
independent paths over the same authenticated sensing occurrence where contracts allow.

Independent admission does not rule out later shared attention/control constraints.
Preserve acquisition-gated cueing B as an explicit coupled comparator. The capacity-zero
fixture must hold sensing, old memory and recall ranking fixed, with only durable gate
capacity varied. Whole source/permission and public read/persistence proof remain required.
# First direct interoceptive recall law

2026-09-12. **DECISION REQUIRED.** Separate retrieval partitions are accepted;
the supplied ruling explicitly requires a separately reviewed body signal-cue law.
## Settled substrate and missing operand

Retained body acquisitions contain surviving InteroceptiveSignalId groups with exact
bounded observer-safe samples, original acquisition time and stable acquisition identity.
Same-signal views are not independent ranking votes. Physical reserve identity, depletion,
pressure, view count and interval width have no accepted recall-priority meaning.
The accepted body path has no learned graph and no shared event/body score scale.

Original acquisition time exists and survives partial fragmentation unchanged. Its
accepted use for retention does not automatically authorize it as recall order. MEC-010
provides an exact presentation-history accessibility control; applying it to body recall
would explicitly connect completed presentation/use to later body accessibility. Public
body presentation history and seed/update bounds have not been qualified.
## Common proposed cue boundary

An actually completed, current, observer-safe body cue names an admitted signal through
the governed channel-to-signal projection. Subject comes through accepted PRJ/IDN.
For the first control propose exact signal-identity matching against surviving groups;
at least one match makes that retained acquisition a candidate. Multiple matching
signals or views do not give extra priority. Unavailable/no lawful cue gives no candidates;
sample numerical zero is not absence. Old retained content or source IDs cannot generate
a current cue. No interval similarity, symptom interpretation, Need or physiological
truth comparison is introduced. Exact public cue producer/permission remains a gate.
## Alternatives

**A — Direct Signal / Acquisition-Recency Recall Baseline (recommended first).** Among
eligible acquisitions, rank newest original acquisition time first; resolve exact ties
by canonical acquisition identity solely for determinism. Apply the body-only slot
bound, without consulting presentation history, encoding strength or graph activation.
Reads return only still-retained content under the ordinary-memory contract. No read
refreshes acquisition time or changes retention. This is a new explicit recall policy
using an existing operand, not a deduction from the Recency Retention Baseline.

Demonstrate multiple eligible retained acquisitions exceeding slots. Hold retained state
fixed when testing recall, so newest-first recall is not merely observing that retention
already deleted all older candidates. Preserve retained-but-unrecalled older targets.
Current cue presence changes eligibility without writing memory. This baseline cannot
explain an older frequently used body recollection outranking newer matching content.

**B — Direct Signal / Presentation-Accessibility Recall now.** Keep the same cue gate,
but explicitly apply a separately versioned body accessibility rule to authenticated
completed presentation history. MEC-010 is the available serious control, not an
automatic cross-kind calibration. Close acquisition seed semantics, whether initial
formation counts as presentation, successful-use feedback, duplicate binding, finite
history retention, and no failed/ranked-only reinforcement before public implementation.
## Executed distinction and research limits

The BRD-A supplied-operand test uses actual presentationAccessibility: at t10, an old
acquisition at1 with histories[1,9] has accessibility3/5, while a newer acquisition at8
with history[8] has1/3, using lambda1 and exponent1. A prefers the newer target; B's
control prefers the older one. These histories are mathematical operands, not qualified
public body-presentation producers. Their distinction is a causal feedback choice.

Neither option returns forgotten groups, adds body association state, turns recall into
workspace admission, or permits other-kind results to alter priority. B remains a serious
comparison if A goes first. The already mandatory episodic acquired-protection comparison
is separate and is not discharged by either recall policy. Whole General Attention,
public persistence, later affect feedback and corpus promotion remain OPEN.

This packet requests acceptance of A's exact signal gate and acquisition-recency order,
or B's presentation-accessibility direction. No body ranking implementation or numeric
allocation has been made from the existing fields alone.
# Direct signal / acquisition-recency body recall: A accepted

2026-09-12. **ACCEPTED by supplied planning ruling.** Resolves the body recall law
decision. Actual lawful current signal matching determines binary acquisition eligibility;
original acquisition time determines within-body ranking. Multiple matching signals,
views or retained groups supply no extra priority. Canonical IDs resolve exact ties only.

Original time never refreshes through recall, presentation, consolidation, fragmentation
or survival. Recall-recency is independently versioned from retention-recency despite
sharing that operand. The public experiment must retain older matching acquisitions
that lose recall slots, avoiding a survivorship tautology.

Absent/denied/unavailable current evidence creates no cue. Numeric zero is evidence,
not epistemic absence. Retained content, source IDs and trace cannot self-cue. The
successful target is the acquisition: a cue for alpha may expose still-retained beta
from that same acquisition, without asserting beta is present now. Group-local recall
is a separate future hypothesis, not the first profile.

Preserve presentation-history accessibility as the next serious body-recall comparator
requiring authenticated use, seed semantics, bounded history and anti-bootstrap rules.
Accessibility reinforcement is distinct from acquired retention protection; neither
qualifies the other. General Attention remains OPEN.
# Interoceptive evidence entering durable memory

2026-09-12. **OPEN architectural decision.** Attribution-gated consolidation and
immediate durable initial encoding remain accepted; neither decision is reopened.
## Concrete question

When a character sees several objects and senses a bodily change, should retaining
that body evidence compete for the **same encoding-selection capacity** as visual
event/continuant units, or pass through a **separate bounded interoceptive encoding
gate** with explicit eligibility and capacity of its own?

This affects what the character can later remember and use as attribution evidence.
It is not a new ID choice, a generic-payload convenience or permission to store every
permitted observation. Both candidates must make excluded evidence unavailable to
later attribution; neither may quietly retain a full observation archive.
## Why the existing contracts do not select an answer

The accepted bounded attention pool groups actual perceived bindings by event-file
and continuant-file and derives role eligibility. Its selected view exposes those
bindings/claims only. The proposed memory retains only positive encoded units.

Actual EMB sensing produces sample461/462 and a support-only227. It supplies no
event-file, continuant-file or role. The installed selector therefore produces an
empty pool for that experience, and selected observation access rejects. These are
executed IA-B1/B2 component findings, not inference from schema names alone.

Architecture §3.2 routes interoception directly into appraisal/motive and §8 separates
episodic encoding from later memory access. Those boundaries support current EMB
pressure without making all body evidence permanently remembered. They do not define
a common visual/interoceptive memory-selection budget or its priority comparison.
Adding a body item to old530 would require a different unit domain, not a fake body
continuant or a manufactured Cause role. Keeping a hidden numeric sidecar instead
would bypass selected-only retention.
## Recommended first implementation: separate bounded encoding gate

Preserve the existing visual event/continuant pool and its exact controls. Add a
separately declared interoceptive encoding gate for admitted body evidence. It must
have explicit source permission, eligibility, capacity/selection, immutable initial
retention, subject ownership and later read authorization. A denied, unavailable or
unselected body sample contributes no retained operand. Source availability alone
does not guarantee memory formation.

This preserves the existing direct pressure path while making persistent body
evidence an explicit acquisition result. The contrastive attribution consumer can
use retained body evidence only when this gate admitted it. Observation identity and
existing subject projection are reused; no invented perceived body object is needed.
The exact body-memory carrier and a lawful noncausal episode/outcome pairing still
require a whole seam, separate allocation and public proof.

The behavioral prediction is that extra visual competitors need not displace body
memory when the independently admitted body gate is held fixed. That is a bounded
research hypothesis, not a universal claim of independent human attention resources.
Shared-resource competition remains a named future comparator, not a retired theory.
## Alternative: shared heterogeneous selection capacity

Admit body evidence as an explicitly different unit variant in a successor attention
contract and make it compete with visual units. Define a common capacity metric,
comparable priorities, tie rules and mixed-modality counterfactuals. No old selector
or old model identity changes in place. Retention remains selected-only for every
variant. The direct transient EMB pressure route need not be altered by this memory
competition, but that distinction must remain explicit.

Here a newly competing visual item can displace body evidence and remove later
attribution support even while the character still experiences transient pressure.
This is a different cognitive prediction, not a larger numeric bound on the same
existing pool.
## Discriminating fixture and preservation burden

Hold body observation bytes, permission, time, initial character and outcome fixed.
Add eligible visual competitors. Compare which body operands survive and whether
the later contrastive assessment is available. In a second intervention disable
body encoding while preserving transient pressure; later memory/attribution must
lose the operand without rewriting that earlier pressure output.

Both candidates also require separate unavailable/zero/denied controls, exact retained
sample bytes, no hidden truth read, no fabricated event/continuant identity, proper
PRJ/IDN, immutable prior episodes and whole-instant rollback/restore. No public vector
is passed by the24 current component/fixture tests or six attribution mutations.

**Requested ruling:** use the separate bounded interoceptive encoding gate first
(recommended), or require shared heterogeneous capacity in the first integrated
model. This determines the new source/retention topology before permanent layouts.
# Separate bounded interoceptive durable encoding: accepted direction

2026-09-12. Records the user's supplied planning analysis. **Topology subdecision
ACCEPTED.** General ATTN-001 remains OPEN. Lifecycle B and attribution-gated credit
are unchanged. The historical decision request remains unchanged as history.

Use a separate bounded interoceptive durable-acquisition gate first. Visual/event
and body evidence remain distinct unit domains with separately declared permissions,
eligibility and capacity. Do not invent an event/continuant or role for a body sample.
Do not introduce a visual/body priority exchange rate through a codec or shared list.

Permitted body observation and transient experienced pressure do not imply durable
retention. The body gate must exhibit actual within-modality contention: more eligible
candidates than capacity causes at least one operand to miss acquisition. A singleton
allow-list cannot qualify this obligation. Holding body-gate inputs fixed while adding
visual competitors produces no direct displacement in this first model.

Selected body evidence must enter first-class durable memory under explicit ownership,
retention and retrieval rules. A peer retained representation or generalized episode
carrier remains a layout question; neither permits a secret remembered-values dictionary.
Unselected, denied or unavailable sample bytes cannot later be recovered from an
observation archive by attribution, consolidation or another learning consumer.

This does not establish universally independent attention resources. Preserve shared
acquisition and shared-control allocation as explicit future competing models. Later
workspace/control may introduce mixed-modality competition. No such mechanism or
reduction is accepted here, and visual distraction is not ruled out as a phenomenon.

Freeze the within-body contention and cross-modal invariance pair, plus the
transient-pressure-without-durable-retention control. Also retain exact sample-byte
carriage, source authenticity, selected-only later access, unavailable versus zero,
proper observer/subject binding and rollback/restore obligations. None is publicly
passed by this architectural ruling. Proceed with component, source and whole-seam
work under standing authorization; no reapproval of this topology is needed.
# What consumes one interoceptive acquisition slot?

2026-09-12. **OPEN architectural decision.** Separate bounded body acquisition is
accepted and unchanged. This fixes the unit inside that gate, not visual/body competition.
## Concrete distinction

One bodily reserve is observed through three channels. They may differ in resolution
or may be identical readouts with different observation/channel identities. At body
capacity2, do they consume three competing acquisition slots, or one signal-level slot
with multiple supporting observations?

The actual [component counterexamples](INTEROCEPTIVE_ACQUISITION_COMPONENT_CHECKPOINT.md)
now execute both resolutions and identical readouts through accepted EMB arithmetic,
codecs and the sample-selection control. The control counts three. The existing
public EMB profile supplies only one channel and does not settle this generalized case.
## Recommendation: one bodily signal per acquisition opportunity

Count an explicitly identified observer-side bodily signal as one acquisition unit
per bounded opportunity. Multiple channels/readings of that signal are its bounded
evidence basis, not additional competing units. Signal identity/grouping must be
declared by the admitted observation model and available in its safe projection;
never infer it from hidden body paths, equal numerical values or channel-name parsing.

This prevents duplicate sensor descriptions from consuming additional retention slots
merely because they acquired different IDs. It does not mean observations are free:
source work, number of views per signal and retained byte volume must all have separate
finite bounds. Nor does grouping grant a more precise value: contradictory or differently
resolved samples keep their evidence semantics; no automatic intersection or averaging
is accepted here. Evidence from different instants is not merged merely by signal ID.

Genuine capacity+1 contention must then be witnessed by at least three admitted
signal units at capacity2. That requires a bounded multi-signal source beyond the
one-reserve EMB profile. It must define physical/sensory meanings without inventing
new Need meters or psychological priorities solely to fill the pool. The sample-level
component remains an explicit control rather than being changed or relabeled in place.
## Alternative: each admitted channel sample is one unit

Retain the current equal-priority control's sample granularity in the first public
model. Distinct admitted channels at one instant can compete even when they report
the same underlying signal. Source membership and sampling frequency become part
of the cognitive resource model. Duplicate-channel and duplicate-occurrence rejection
still apply, but two separate channels of the same quantity may consume two slots.

Under this alternative, redundant descriptions can crowd out another readout. That
footprint dependence must remain a measured prediction, not be hidden or called
signal diversity. Public source admission still cannot invent extra arbitrary aliases
at runtime. The finite channel set, physics and sampling schedule must be committed.
Grouping by signal remains a named comparator; neither model is universally true by
construction.
## Why this requires an architectural ruling

The accepted separate-gate review requires genuine within-modality contention but does
not define whether the unit is a sample or a bodily signal. Its explicit caution about
whether persistent sensation counts as one candidate or many is relevant here. These
choices predict different remembered evidence under sensor duplication, change the
candidate key and source domain, and determine the required positive experiment.
Choosing three aliases just to pass the bound would decide the resource ontology
through fixture convenience. The North Star does not supply that unit definition.
## Frozen discriminating obligations

Hold body state, time, visual state and available signal meanings fixed; duplicate
an admitted readout through another channel. Record candidate count, displaced units,
retained evidence and later attribution availability. Separately add a genuinely
different signal while keeping the first signal's evidence fixed; prove the configured
bound can exclude a unit. Preserve unavailable/zero distinctions and never recover
excluded sample bytes through trace or a hidden store.

Different readings of one opportunity cannot fabricate independent trial repetitions
for contrastive attribution under either model. Source permission and actual provenance
must bind the distinction; ordinal differences alone do not prove repeated experience.

**Requested ruling:** signal-per-opportunity acquisition units (recommended), or
channel-sample acquisition units for the first public body gate. No public allocation
or persistent carrier is proposed before this semantic choice is recorded.
# Signal-per-opportunity acquisition: accepted direction

2026-09-12. **Acquisition-unit subdecision ACCEPTED**, from the user's supplied
planning review. General ATTN-001 remains OPEN. Separate bounded body acquisition,
lifecycle B and attribution-gated consolidation remain accepted and unchanged.

One slot represents one observer-side bodily signal in one admitted sensing
opportunity. Multiple channels of that declared signal contribute a bounded evidence
basis, not extra competing units. Distinct experienced signals remain distinct even
when they share a hidden physiological cause. The safe observation model owns the
grouping; equal values, units, similar names and hidden source paths do not establish it.

Opportunity identity comes from actual admitted sensing, not timestamp equality.
Different opportunities remain distinct at the same instant. No new namespace or
parallel occurrence allocator is requested by the review's illustrative OpportunityId.
The public inventory must inspect and reuse an appropriate existing sensing identity
through an explicit admission/projection rule.

Grouping is not evidence integration. Preserve each admitted sample's identity,
censoring, resolution, provenance and exact value. No averaging, intersection,
most-precise selection, voting or uncertainty reduction is licensed. Later consumers
may read only the bounded basis that was selected and retained, not the original
sensing stream. Different views of one opportunity are not independent repeated trials.

Candidate count, selected count, views admitted per signal and retained payload volume
need separate finite bounds. This ruling chooses no public numeric values. A component
may exercise explicit test limits; those are not permanent model commitments.

Retain sample-counting acquisition as an explicit competing control. Its implemented
contract, source and receipts remain unchanged. Shared acquisition/control remains a
separate future resource hypothesis, not retired or silently merged into this gate.

Freeze the paired obligations: an added admitted view of one signal leaves candidate
count/slot use unchanged while its retained basis may differ; three actual signal
units at capacity2 genuinely contend. Also freeze same-time distinct-opportunity
separation, exact contradictory-basis preservation, bounded payloads, authentic safe
grouping and selected-only later access. No public source or memory qualification
follows from this architectural acceptance.
# First genuinely multi-signal bodily source

2026-09-12. **OPEN architectural scope decision.** Signal-level acquisition, separate
body capacity, lifecycle B and attribution-gated credit are accepted and unchanged.
## Why this is now concrete

The public EMB profile has one physically modeled reserve and a permitted level
readout. The grouped gate can select three symbolic groups, but three labels or
resolutions of that readout do not establish three distinct bodily signals. The
required capacity2 versus three-signal experiment needs a real bounded source domain.

There are two materially different ways to supply it: extend the body's physical
state, or extend the sensory mechanisms operating on the existing physical state.
This changes what the model claims exists, beyond codecs or selection arithmetic.
The generic North Star permits both but does not choose these new source meanings.
## Recommended bounded source: three local reserve-level signals

Authorize a successor body profile with three independently modeled local reserve
stocks belonging to one character. They are abstract storage compartments, not named
human organs, new Need meters or three instances of the same readout. Each has an
explicit capacity, anchor/time and nonnegative depletion rate under the existing
accepted reserve mathematics; replenishment targets one declared compartment.

The source exposes separately identifiable observer-side local-level signals through
permitted quantized observations. Each signal may have several bounded resolution
views. Safe signal identity is still explicitly declared by the observation model,
not reconstructed by cognition from hidden compartment keys. This first profile may
map one local-level signal per compartment without establishing a universal rule
that one physical source always means one experienced signal.
Prepared topology:
